recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce ValueSet.extensible into the core resource; any future changes to the extension definition should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-16427 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request against STU3 ValueSet questioning why extensible was a core ValueSet attribute and resolving to remove it from the core resource and make it an extension until sufficient implementation experience existed.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 14125. In git this is be8de212ff, which removed the ValueSet.extensible row from the ValueSet spreadsheet, added the valueset-extensible extension to the then-current ValueSet extensions spreadsheet, and converted the UCUM common ValueSet instance to use the extension URL.
additional_context: Current ValueSet source has since migrated from spreadsheet form to source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml. That active ValueSet StructureDefinition contains no ValueSet.extensible element, while source/fhir.ini still actively lists valueset=ValueSet. The valueset-extensible extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack at input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-extensible.xml, with context ValueSet and a required boolean value. The STU3/R4 history page still records the FHIR-16427 move.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the authoritative current core source is already correct and no core source edit is needed.
